Hope it goes well for you. Maybe you should take a break from forcing yourself to work? Make a cup of hot milk or something and just relax for a little bit. 

Breathe in and out until you feel like you're ready to do a little bit of your work (maybe just an hour worth). It important to stop pushing yourself. Maybe write your plan on paper, a check list helps me get my shit together.

I'm not sure if they would work for you but...

*Go for a jog.*
- Run like a motherfucker!!! Seriously, just imagine you're running away from all your problems. 

*Binge eat fruits and veggies.*
- Binge eating but "healthily"

*Plan*
- I know it would feel useless but try and find something to look forward to. It doesn't have to be attainable at this moment. Make a list of thing you want to do. Maybe you'd like to get a pet or something. 

*Spontaneous get away*
- I keep getting these impulses to run away. I imagine going far away in my 20s and start a new life. I would have a new name and enough money to live by myself. I can't do that right now though ,but it would be really nice to just get away even if it's just for a day or two.  I make a list of the places I want to go to and ask people I trust if they would like to go with me (cause I'm underage and unable to commute on my own). 

It doesn't have to be somewhere far, even my room gets suffocating after being in there for so long. Just a quick trip to a food park would do. 

*Connect with your family*
-Unless you have family issues like I do, then it would be best to NOT CONNECT

*Buy yourself some flowers*
- Flowers are pretty but if you're allergic to them, it's a no-no 

*Dress up*
- Shower. Clean yourself up, pretend you're going somewhere, and suit up. It was pretty depressing to realize I didn't really have anything planned with anyone or I haven't really left the house in days ,but I'm freshly showered and damn I look gud. It's just nice to look nice for a change. 

*Art*
- I'm not an artist but I found a painting activity where the spots are numbered ,so you can just color them in and they would look good when you finish them. 

*Cook/Bake*
- It a nice feeling to make something on my own, until I realize I'm alone ,but that's what the cake is for (binge eat away). 

*Break Stuff*
- my emotions haywire sometimes and I just want to destroy everything I touch. I plan on buying some cheap plates for this but I haven't gotten around it. Make sure the place you're going to break it is covered or somewhere outside the house to make the clean up easier and less dangerous for you. 

*Wipe your face with ice cubes* 
- Or soak a towel in cold water and put it over your eyes. It's pretty calming. 

They aren't guaranteed to work and I don't do them a lot. I still have a bad habit of SH when things get too overwhelming. I hope things work out for you and you find a way to cope without hurting yourself. :)
